notes: These are **official cutoffs** as reproduced from SSC result notices (decimals may differ by ±0.5 between reproductions; the SSC PDF is always canonical). CHSL cutoffs are declared **post-list-wise**: the rows below are for the largest list (LDC/JSA), which is the one most quoted. Tier 1 is only a **screening stage** — its score is not carried into the final merit, which comes from Tier 2. Marks are **normalized** across shifts, so a cutoff is only comparable within its own year.
